preview.title: Freenome — Provider Portal
preview.body: Where a practice watches its orders: find a patient, read a result, place the next test. Driven in the real app.

steps.title: New step
steps.body: What should the reader do here?

steps.title: Every order the practice has placed
steps.body: One list, newest first — **82 orders** across the practice's providers. The {**Status**} column is the whole point of the screen: it says what the lab is waiting on, and who it's waiting on.

steps.title: Find a patient
steps.body: A provider arrives knowing a name, not an order number. Search is by patient, and it filters as you type. [Try typing a few letters.]

steps.title: Or narrow by what's blocking
steps.body: {**On hold**} is the status that needs a human: the lab can't proceed until someone fixes something. Filtering to it turns the list into a to-do.

steps.title: Open an order
steps.body: Every order ID opens a details panel rather than a new page, so you keep your place in the list. **Click one.**

steps.title: Everything about that order
steps.body: Patient, provider, specimen, and the lab's progress through it — plus the report once results are out. [Scroll the panel if you like.]

steps.title: Place the next test
steps.body: Ordering starts from the same screen, so a provider never has to go looking for it. **Click Order a test.**

steps.title: The new-order form
steps.body: Patient, provider, test and clinical history in one pass — then a review step before it's placed. Nothing you do here touches a real database: this walkthrough runs the portal on fixtures.
